lines.en: Oh, my God. I am so glad you called me.
I had the most supremely awful day.
Can I get an espresso and a latte over here, please?
Oh, we got the proofs back in that photo shoot.
You know, the one with the little vegetables?
So I blew off the rest of the afternoon.
Well, I knew you had the Rockies, and so I figured, you know,
you could wear Bullwinkle and Bullwinkle,
or you could wear Rocky and Rocky,
or you can mix and match moose and squirrel.
Well, I'm gonna get another espresso.
Oh, yeah, the hug looked pretty brutal.
